name: Marchal (Spain)
description: White field with a crimson fly stripe, charged towards the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Marchal (a church, a cross of Saint James, cliffs and grapes).
history: Municipal flag of Marchal; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Marchal arms — church, cross of Saint James, cliffs and grapes
